latest.name: Ideogram — AI Image Generator & Editor (4.6)
latest.short_verdict: Ideogram is a typography-aware image generation and editing workspace for posters, logos, packaging and social graphics. Its Free plan lists 30 credits per week, but free generations are public and downloads are limited to original-size JPEG. The new 4.6 model focuses on precise multi-step edits up to 4K; its exact in-app credit cost varies by settings and is shown before generation. Strong for text-led visual work, but not unlimited production or confidential assets.
latest.what_it_does: Ideogram turns text prompts and reference images into visuals, with tools for readable text, logos, posters, packaging, vector artwork, background/object removal, resizing and image editing. Ideogram 4.6, released November 19, 2026, is focused on precise multi-step edits: it supports up to five reference images for Generate, optional masks for Precise Edit, and output up to 4K. The platform also offers earlier image models and a browser-based Studio.
latest.why_try_it: It is particularly worth testing when the image itself needs a headline, brand name, label or designed typography rather than leaving all lettering for a separate editor. It also supports focused edits to an existing image, so a creator can change a product color or detail without restarting the whole composition. Treat results as drafts and proofread all text before publishing.
latest.free_tier: The official Plans and Credits guide lists the Free plan at $0 with 30 credits each week. The clearest documented eligibility is Google or Apple sign-in; official Ideogram pages conflict about Microsoft sign-in (the FAQ says Microsoft qualifies, while the Quick Start note says it does not). Email/password sign-up receives no free credits. As a reference only, the published Ideogram 4.5 and 4.0 image rates are 3, 6 or 10 credits per image at the listed quality settings, so 30 credits would cover roughly 10, 5 or 3 such images. The 4.6 app-credit quote is settings-dependent and must be checked on the Generate button; do not assume the older model rates apply.
latest.limits: Free generations are public. Free downloads are original-size JPEG; PNG, WebP and upscaled sizes require a paid plan or Pay as you go credits. Video and premium apps may require a paid plan or purchased credits. The exact in-app credit charge for Ideogram 4.6 is not published as one fixed figure; the app shows a quote for each run. Ideogram's FAQ says text rendering is strongest in English and other Latin-script languages; non-Latin scripts can render incorrectly or not at all, so Urdu/Arabic lettering should be added or checked separately. Do not place confidential client material in a free workspace because generated images are public.
latest.signup_pakistan: No Pakistan-specific signup prohibition was found in the official public pages reviewed, but registration and generation from Pakistan were not hands-on tested, so access is not guaranteed. For the clearest documented free eligibility, use Google or Apple sign-in. The free tier does not require a paid checkout. Paid billing is listed in USD and processed by card through Stripe; acceptance of Pakistani cards and any bank conversion fees were not verified.
latest.quality_evidence: Vendor claims: Ideogram describes its models as designed for legible text and its 4.6 model as a precise multi-step editor. The 4.6 page reports a first-place Rapidata Multi-step Image Edit benchmark score of 1,892 (November 17, 2026 snapshot); this is a vendor-published benchmark result for a specified high-quality Precise Edit configuration, not a guarantee for every prompt. Independent evidence: Contra Labs' blind evaluation used 10 working designers, four models and 240 images across 60 prompts; Ideogram 4.0 won 47.9% of typography matchups and scored 3.92/5 for typographic craft. That small study tested 4.0, not the newly released 4.6. Anecdotal community feedback: a June 2026 Reddit user reported strong poster layout and text-style control with Ideogram 4, but said the results required detailed bounding boxes and many prompt iterations. No hands-on generation test was performed for this report.
latest.android_status: No official Android app was verified. Ideogram's own documentation lists the web app, iOS app and API as access methods, but does not list an Android app. Similarly named Google Play apps are published by unrelated developers and should not be treated as official.
